features.apple: Localizable: 2nd / Alternate Functions, Secondary Functions (or hold Shift)
features.note: The 2nd key (calc.rs:156) switches the scientific keypad to its second layer; holding Shift does not switch it. The SDK app protocol carries no modifier state, so the held-Shift switch needs an SDK input addition first.
features.wire: Add a modifier-state input to the SDK app protocol, then treat a held Shift as Act::Second while it is down and redraw the keypad labels.

features.wire: Compare the second-layer labels and their order with the reference keypad on Midget.

features.feature: Programmer mode (hex/dec/oct/bin bases, bitwise AND/OR/XOR/NOR/NOT, shifts, rotate, byte/word flip, 2's complement, binary view, ASCII/Unicode display)
features.apple: Localizable: Programmer, Hexadecimal, Bitwise …, Shift Left/Right, Rotate, Byte Flip, Word Flip, Show Binary, ASCII value, Unicode value
features.note: Programmer is a toolbar segment (calc.rs:755) and View > Programmer (cmd+3, calc/menu.rs:47) driving programmer::Programmer, with the A-F and operator keypad, a clickable bit row, and a readout of the Unicode code point, the character and the ASCII code (programmer.rs readout, tested there). Show Binary is not a toggle yet, and it is not tested on Midget.
features.wire: Show the ASCII value next to the Unicode readout, then verify the keypad on Midget.

features.feature: RPN mode (enter, drop, swap, roll up/down, stack display)
features.apple: Localizable: RPN Mode On/Off, Enter, Drop, Swap, Rotate stack up/down
features.note: RPN Mode (View, cmd+R, calc/menu.rs:102) routes the basic keypad to rpn::Rpn, with Enter, Swap, Drop and Roll Up and Down in the Stack menu (calc/menu.rs:126-129); the model is tested in rpn.rs. The values below X are drawn on the line above the display (calc.rs:1149), in one row of text that truncates when the stack is deep. Not tested on Midget.
features.wire: Draw the stack() values above the display in RPN mode, then verify on Midget.

features.wire: Add a search field over all units and a recent-units list stored in settings.

features.wire: Verify on Midget that the View items merge into the shell View menu.

features.apple: Localizable: Always on Top
features.note: Window > Always on Top is a ticked item. bifrost_app::windows::set_level sends ToShell::WindowLevel (proto tag 0x165); the app host keeps the level (apphost.rs window_level), the shell sets the desk order and the frames (desk.rs band_top, sync_levels, take_wayland_windows), and bare/wayland.rs sends bifrost_window_level_v1 set_level for the window surface. The window server (springboard/wm/src/window_level.rs, wm.rs Level) keeps floating windows above normal ones through map, raise and focus. Built and run only on the host by reading: not verified on Midget.
features.wire: Build the workspace and check the item and the stacking on Midget: open Calculator, choose Window > Always on Top, raise another window over it.
